title: Vegetarian Bibimbap
description: This bibimbap recipe is a vegetarian version of the classic Korean rice bowl with warm white rice and tender mixed veggies, topped with a fried egg.
ingredients: 3 teaspoons sweet red chili sauce, or to taste

steps.text: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir carrot and zucchini in the hot oil until vegetables begin to soften, about 5 minutes. Stir in bean sprouts, bamboo shoots, and mushrooms. Cook and stir until carrots are tender, about 5 more minutes. Season to taste with salt; transfer vegetable mixture to a plate.
Stir cooked rice, green onions, soy sauce, and black pepper in the same skillet until the rice is hot.
In a separate skillet over medium heat, melt butter and gently fry eggs, turning once, until the yolks are still slightly runny but the egg whites are firm, about 3 minutes per egg.
To serve, divide hot cooked rice mixture between 3 serving bowls and top each bowl with 1/3 of the vegetable mixture and a fried egg. Serve with sweet red chili sauce.

video.description: Easy to assemble and delicious to eat, this well balanced and nutritious dish is Korean comfort food at its best. Cook matchsticks of carrots and zucchini in hot sesame oil, then stir in bean sprouts, bamboo shoots and mushrooms, season with salt. Stir together cooked rice with green onion, soy sauce and black pepper, then fry eggs in butter. Divide the rice among bowls, arrange the colorful, cooked veggies all around, and top with fried egg and drizzle with sweet red chili sauce.
